interpretation: This new study measures contemporaneous same-mode repeatability and cross-mode separation under matching position/lag strata. It cannot retrospectively explain old magnitude rates without stationarity assumptions, identify pure encryption/CPU cost, establish independent routes, deconvolve noise, or turn pair fractions into population probabilities. No p-values, population/equivalence CI, or causal network effect.
weighting: For each run/provider/flow condition, give each planned observed window equal mass; within a window give each common cell equal mass; within a class/cell give each eligible pair equal mass. This balances DU having four times as many candidate pairs as UU or DD. If any planned window has no common overlap, report the pooled primary estimate unavailable, while retaining window results.
quantile_definition: Weighted empirical inverse-CDF: smallest observed value with normalized cumulative weight >= requested quantile (left-continuous search). State this separately from an ordinary interpolated median.
